(async () => { const deadline = Date.now() + 90000; while (Date.now() < deadline) { const launch = document.querySelector('[data-testid="new-terminal-button"]'); if (launch) return; const retry = document.querySelector('[data-testid="health-retry-button"]'); if (retry instanceof HTMLButtonElement && !retry.disabled) { retry.click(); } await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 500)); } throw new Error('New terminal button did not appear within timeout'); })()

(() => { if (window.__bas_ws_tracker_installed) return; window.__bas_ws_tracker_installed = true; window.__bas_ws_instances = []; window.__bas_ws_output = {}; const NativeWebSocket = window.WebSocket; const sessionIdFromUrl = (value) => { try { const url = String(value || ''); const match = url.match(/\/sessions\/([^/]+)\/ws/); return match ? match[1] : ''; } catch { return ''; } }; class TrackingWebSocket extends NativeWebSocket { constructor(...args) { super(...args); this.__bas_session_id = sessionIdFromUrl(args[0]); this.addEventListener('message', (event) => { try { const text = typeof event.data === 'string' ? event.data : ''; if (!text) return; const parsed = JSON.parse(text); if (parsed && parsed.type === 'stdout' && typeof parsed.data === 'string' && this.__bas_session_id) { const previous = window.__bas_ws_output[this.__bas_session_id] || ''; window.__bas_ws_output[this.__bas_session_id] = (previous + parsed.data).slice(-12000); } } catch {} }); window.__bas_ws_instances.push(this); } } window.WebSocket = TrackingWebSocket; })()
